findings.detail: The 7:3 plate is centered, symmetrical, face-on, fully contained, and framed by even transparent padding.
Muted gold-bronze bevels, dark iron separation, and restrained wear align with the two medallion assets while preserving primary-action emphasis.
The central 60 percent is visually calm, has no baked-in ornament, and remains mechanically fully opaque across the recorded validation crop.
The outside background is transparent with zero-alpha corners and edges and no measured visible green pixels.
No glyph, text, digits, pseudo-writing, identity, character, official logo, class or specialization mark, or recognizable WoW object is present.
The clipped silhouette, bevel hierarchy, center face, and end rivets remain distinct at the intended reduced size.

runtimeReviewRequirements: Render at the intended approximately 84x36 CSS optical size without non-uniform scaling or additional cropping.
Place the trusted runtime glyph and label in separate centered layers and preserve adequate contrast against the dark-bronze face.
Confirm label fit, pressed and disabled states, and card alignment in the real BuildIntelCard composition before promotion.
